meta.title: Principia Orthogona
meta.subtitle: Complete Completeness Series — G1 through G6
meta.author: Pablo Nogueira Grossi

rings.title: Ring 1 — The Operators
rings.subtitle: Singularity-Theoretic Foundations
rings.description: Establishes the operator chain C→K→F→U. Singularity theory, Whitney A₁ fold, the geometric origin of non-commutativity. The wholesale before the retail.

rings.title: Ring 2 — Contact Geometry
rings.subtitle: The dm³ Realization
rings.description: Contact-geometric realization via the dm³ toy model on M = ℝ²₊ × ℝ with α = dz − r²dθ. Limit cycle Γ = {r=1}, T* = 2π, μₘₐₓ = −2. The shape that was always there.

rings.title: Ring 3 — The Time Circuit
rings.subtitle: GTCT: Spiral Return · Lean 4 Verified
rings.description: Establishes T as the fifth operator. Theorem T1 (Spiral Return): the G⁶⁴-orbit is generative, not periodic. Gronwall bound ε₀=1/3. Inner basin r*≈0.773. 4 theorems proved, 2 honest axioms. 0 sorry.

rings.title: Ring 4 — The Coherence Bridge
rings.subtitle: 17 Domains · 17 Orders of Magnitude
rings.description: Coherence Bridge Theorem (5.4): 17 domains from HPA stress to Saturn's hexagon are objects in the same category dm³. Explicit contact morphisms fᵢⱼ: Xᵢ → Xⱼ. One operator sequence. All substrates.

rings.title: Ring 5 — Complete Completeness
rings.subtitle: The Seed · A Semente · Bilingual IMPA Edition
rings.description: Volume V. The bilingual dream. AXLE as mathematics as language. The student edition. The Princípio do Cajueiro. For Brazil, for every mind that knows something before it can prove it.

rings.title: Ring 6 — AXLE
rings.subtitle: The Living Proof Series · 100+ Theorems · Growing
rings.description: Formal verification in Lean 4. Each chapter isolates one domain and proves the dm³ contact morphism. 0 sorry policy. This ring never closes — it grows with every new proof.

open_problems.title: Poincaré–Collatz (general)
open_problems.description: General case: does every GChain orbit satisfy dist(Gⁿx, Gⁿ⁺¹x) < r* for some n? The contracting case (k<1) is proved. The general case is the dm³ analogue of Collatz.

open_problems.title: Inner basin analytic boundary
open_problems.description: r* ≈ 0.773 is identified numerically. An analytic expression is unknown. Lean axiom: inner_basin_is_asymmetric.

open_problems.title: BSD–GTCT Bridge
open_problems.description: Is the accumulated TE orbit cost the discrete analogue of log L(E,1)? Stated as GTCT.BSD.BSDGTCTConjecture in Lean 4. $1M Millennium Prize.
